[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,100 (Sandbox) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5.5) |spawned_by = [[Stunt Man]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Stunt Man Double''', which uses the display name of just '''Stunt Man''', was an enemy that appeared in [[The Final Act Event]]. It can be spawned by the [[Stunt Man]]. ==Logbook Description== "''This daredevil was once a celebrated stunt performer, known for their death-defying acts and fearless attitude. However, a tragic accident during a high-risk stunt left them trapped in a liminal space between life and death. Now, they roam the battlefield, driven by an insatiable urge to perform their stunts, regardless of the consequences.''" ==Appearance== Like [[Stunt Man]], the '''Stunt Man Double''' is a daredevil with a black body. It wears a red vest, pants and hat, all with gold accents. It also has a white shirt and frilled gloves, black shoes and a white mask. It has two walking animations to choose from. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The [[Hacker]] can be used to prevent the '''Stunt Man Double''' from spawning from the [[Stunt Man]]. *High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Warlock]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. *The '''Stunt Man Double''' is quite fast, making stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Electroshocker]] useful against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} StuntManSpawn.gif|Spawning animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManSpawn2.gif|Spawning animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManWalk.gif|Walking animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManWalk2.gif|Walking animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManDeath.gif|Death animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) StuntManDeath2.gif|Death animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseStuntMan.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseStuntMan2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Stunt Man Double''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Stunt Man Double''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. == Update History == *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Stunt Man Double''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Stunt Man Double''' has a broken icon. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Stunt Man Double''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:The Final Act Event]]
